definitions.gloss: as one; united; coming together as a unified body
definitions.explanation: An expression describing a group of people uniting as a single body to work toward a common goal. Emphasizes solidarity, teamwork, and collective effort.

examples.japanese: チームが{一丸|いちがん}となって{戦|たたか}った。
{社員|しゃいん}{全員|ぜんいん}が{一丸|いちがん}となって{目標|もくひょう}に{取|と}り{組|く}んだ。
examples.english: All employees united and worked toward the goal.

examples.japanese: {被災地|ひさいち}の{復興|ふっこう}に{向|む}けて、{地域|ちいき}が{一丸|いちがん}となって{力|ちから}を{合|あ}わせている。
examples.english: The community is coming together as one and joining forces toward the recovery of the disaster area.

notes:
{一丸|いちがん} literally means 'one ball' or 'one mass,' and となって means 'becoming.' The expression conveys the image of many individuals merging into a single entity. It is frequently used in sports coverage, business settings, and discussions of community efforts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一丸|いちがん}となって{取|と}り{組|く}む (to work on something as one)
- {一丸|いちがん}となって{戦|たたか}う (to fight as one)
- {一丸|いちがん}となって{努力|どりょく}する (to make a united effort)
- {一丸|いちがん}となって{立|た}ち{向|む}かう (to stand up together against something)

USAGE:
This expression is especially common in encouraging speeches, news reporting on team sports, and descriptions of collective action during crises or challenges. It conveys a strong, motivational tone.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {団結|だんけつ}する — to unite, to band together (more formal; emphasizes the act of unifying)
- {力|ちから}を{合|あ}わせる — to join forces (more neutral and everyday)
- {結束|けっそく}する — to rally together, to unite (emphasizes solidarity and cohesion)
